newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Bank sees annual double digit growth.
newsitem.headline: DBS Bank sees annual double digit growth.

text.p: The Development Bank of Singapore Ltd said on Thursday it expects steady double digit growth in net profits until the turn of the century.
"We expect...to achieve double digit growth (in net profit) every year to the year 2000," DBS Bank President Ng Kee Choe told reporters at a briefing after the release of 1996 results.
He said the bank had previously announced that its target was to reach Singapore $1 billion in net profit by the year 2000. "We would have to increase by double digits to reach that," he said.
DBS Bank earlier on Thursday announced net profit of $669.45 million in 1996.
